sloka: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना श्रुत्वा तामद्भुतां गिरम् ।अदग्द्धा जानकीत्येवं निमित्तैश्चोपलक्षिता ।। ५.५८.१६० ।।।।
transliteration: tato me buddhirutpannā śrutvā tāmadbhutāṁ giram ।adagddhā jānakītyevaṁ nimittaiścopalakṣitā ।। 5.58.160 ।।।।

translations.english: "It was amazing to hear the words of the charanas. On hearing that Jankai had not been burnt, I understood that it is on her account (that he is also not burnt although his tail was ignited.)
